title: Trump administration set to receive $10 billion ‘fee’ for brokering TikTok deal
title_zh: 特朗普政府将因 TikTok 交易收取 100 亿美元“费用”
summary: Investing.com — The Trump administration is poised to receive a roughly $10 billion "brokerage" fee from the investor group that recently took control of TikTok’s U.S. operations, according to a report by the Wall Street Journal.
summary_zh: Investing.com——据《华尔街日报》报道，特朗普政府准备从最近控制 TikTok 美国业务的投资集团那里获得约 100 亿美元的“经纪”费。

title: US to Receive $10 Billion Fee for TikTok Deal, WSJ Reports
title_zh: 《华尔街日报》报道，美国将因 TikTok 交易收取 100 亿美元费用
summary: A federal law required TikTok to either be shut down in the US or sold to domestic owners at the beginning of President Donald Trump’s second term.  The White House did not immediately respond to a request for comment, but Trump had previously alluded to such a fee.
summary_zh: 一项联邦法律要求 TikTok 在美国被关闭，或者在唐纳德·特朗普总统第二任期开始时出售给国内所有者。  白宫没有立即回应置评请求，但特朗普此前曾提到过此类费用。

title: Applied Optoelectronics’ (AAOI) Mega $200 Million Deal Catches Analyst Attention
title_zh: 应用光电 (AAOI) 2 亿美元的巨额交易引起了分析师的关注
summary: Applied Optoelectronics, Inc. (NASDAQ:AAOI) is one of the 11 Best Day Trading Stocks to Buy Now. Financial firm Rosenblatt discussed Applied Optoelectronics, Inc. (NASDAQ:AAOI)’s shares on March 9th, according to The Fly.
summary_zh: 应用光电公司（纳斯达克股票代码：AAOI）是 11 只最值得立即买入的日内交易股票之一。据 The Fly 报道，金融公司 Rosenblatt 于 3 月 9 日讨论了应用光电公司（纳斯达克股票代码：AAOI）的股票。

title: Salesforce surges 3% on $25 billion debt offering to fund massive share buyback
title_zh: Salesforce 股价飙升 3%，发行 250 亿美元债券为大规模股票回购提供资金
summary: The cloud software giant said it will deploy all net proceeds from the debt issuance into ASR transactions with certain financial institution counterparties, with prepayment and initial share delivery expected to occur on March 16, 2026.
summary_zh: 这家云软件巨头表示，将把债券发行的所有净收益用于与某些金融机构交易对手的 ASR 交易，预付款和首次股份交付预计将于 2026 年 3 月 16 日进行。
